summary.title: RAVNDAL HOLDING AS

narrative.text: RAVNDAL HOLDING AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom", registered 2014-10-28.
Registered activity: Utleie av fast eiendom. Investering i aksjer og verdipapirer.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 1.3 million and an annual result of NOK 4,778.
Registered leadership: Knut Arve Ravndal (Daglig leder); Knut Arve Ravndal (Styrets leder).
Head office in Ålgård, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.

revenue_comparison.derivation: absolute_change = latest_revenue - previous_revenue; percent_change = absolute_change / previous_revenue * 100 (only when previous_revenue > 0)

summary.revenue_comparison_text: Revenue was NOK 1.3 million in 2025, up from NOK 1.2 million in 2024, an increase of NOK 21,738 (1.8%).

value.beskrivelse: Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom

value: Utleie av bygg og maskiner, kjøp og salg av eiendom, og andre

aksjer eller på annen måte gjøre seg interessert i andre foretak.
